body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. One bench from requirement to validated prototype package. A universal invention workbench chains requirements, research, generative design, simulation, code generation, manufacturing prep, and verification into one traceable flow. It keeps every artifact linked, re-runs affected steps on change, and exports a complete invention package. Real implementations compose PLM, CAD, solvers, and CI into guided workflows.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Universal Engineering Invention Workbench, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (End-to-end pipeline: requirements to prototype package). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: End-to-end pipeline: requirements to prototype package and Automatic re-execution of affected steps on change. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Universal Engineering Lab Coordinator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
